name: How can I make my home remodel more energy-efficient?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my home remodel more energy-efficient?

acceptedAnswer.text: To enhance energy efficiency during a remodel, consider upgrading insulation in walls, attics, and floors, installing energy-efficient windows and doors, and opting for ENERGY STAR-rated appliances. You can also integrate smart home technology for optimized climate control, switch to LED lighting, and choose high-efficiency HVAC systems. Even small changes, such as sealing air leaks, can significantly reduce energy consumption and lower utility bills in the long run. Discuss these options with your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improve energy efficiency by upgrading insulation, installing ENERGY STAR windows/appliances, using LED lighting, and sealing air leaks. Consider smart home tech and high-efficiency HVAC.
